releaseNotes: Ket noi AI qua API: (1) Ollama / VietEcom Private AI o may khac - them o Khoa API, noi qua Open WebUI (http://<IP>:8080/ollama), giu nguyen toi uu AI noi bo. (2) The moi "API tuong thich OpenAI" - Open WebUI, LM Studio, vLLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Groq, OpenRouter; chon theo tung tinh nang. Sua loi: o Model Ollama tu chon nham mo hinh vector hoa (bge-m3).
